recent.text: As I reported last week, this is how tendinopathy is generally treated. It’s a slow process, first with treatment/rest (which he’s progressed through) and then gradual loading/strength training. What the Raptors don’t want is for Kawhi to come back and have another flare up.
recent.author: Josh Lewenberg
recent.quoted_text: Kawhi Leonard has been dealing with patellar tendinopathy, per sources — the same recurring condition that the Raptors managed in 2019. On why the team is being cautious and when he could return: https://t.co/GHBPliQs3X
